name: compare_abundance
description: giap compare: per unordered run pair, Spearman rho of log2 abundance on the shared detected and measured genes with a TU-block bootstrap percentile CI, and Bland-Altman bias and 95% limits of agreement (GIAP_SPEC.md §7.9.3, §8.2, §8.3; M9-22, ADR-0046). The table has no coordinate fields.

fields.name: run_a
fields.description: First run of the pair (label order)

fields.name: n_shared
fields.description: Genes detected with a measured (not imputed) abundance in both runs

fields.name: spearman_rho
fields.description: Spearman rank correlation (average ranks for ties)

fields.name: ci_low
fields.description: Lower bound of the 95% TU-block bootstrap percentile CI of rho

fields.name: ci_high
fields.description: Upper bound of the 95% TU-block bootstrap percentile CI of rho

fields.name: ba_bias_log2
fields.description: Bland-Altman bias: mean of log2 a - log2 b

fields.name: ba_loa_low
fields.description: Lower limit of agreement: bias - 1.96 SD (ddof 1)

fields.name: ba_loa_high
fields.description: Upper limit of agreement: bias + 1.96 SD (ddof 1)
